The datasheet lists MMBT5401LT1G, SMMBT5401LT1G, and MMBT5401LT3G together as a PNP silicon high-voltage transistor family; the exact target MMBT5401LT1G is listed in the ordering information on p. 1.

PNP table quantities retain the datasheet negative signs. Typical-characteristic plot coordinates are recorded as magnitudes because Figures 1-6 and 9-12 plot positive magnitudes while their test labels identify the PNP bias polarity.
The electrical-characteristics table gives guaranteed minimum or maximum bounds. No typical hFE value was substituted for those bounds; the separate curve entries are digitized typical readings.
Curve points are manual digitizations of visible plotted traces at axis-aligned coordinates and are not interpolated between points.

Figure 9 provides typical Cobo and Cibo curves; the tabulated Cobo maximum is retained in specs.cobo, while Cibo is reported only as a digitized typical curve value because no Cibo table row is present.

Figure 12 prints the collector-current axis unit as A even though its plotted range and the datasheet fT table use milliamp-scale operating currents; the curve axis metadata preserves the printed A label.
The electrical-characteristics table heading states TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
